cause: The v1.5.0 frontend never materializes the model. A fixed DYN_TCP_RPC_PORT skips request-plane server initialization, then eager Option::unwrap_or evaluates get_actual_tcp_rpc_port() before its global value exists. Model discovery retries; chat and completions remain disabled and return empty 404 responses.
endpoint_defaults: The false endpoint flags are initial state. A successful ModelUpdate::Added enables Chat and Completions automatically.
stock_workaround: Unset DYN_TCP_RPC_PORT for the image frontend so build_transport_type initializes its TCP server. Keep backend RPC20000 and frontend response20003. Restart only the owned frontend with a new epoch and retain the original one-token completions canary and reset checks.
main_status: Pinned main always initializes the TCP request-plane server before constructing the transport address.
verification_still_required: Frontend successfully materializes Qwen and /v1/models lists it.
Original one-token canary completes with cached_tokens=0.
Current frontend records clear event, success=true and global_radix_tree_size=0.
